simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מִכְמַן (H4362) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: מִכְמַן (mikman) means treasure (as hidden) First listed occurrence: Dan 11 43.

definitions.full: H4362. mikman [ מִכְמָן ] noun [masculine] only plural hidden stores , וְהַכֶּסֶף הַזָּהָב מִכְמַנֵּי Dan 11:43 ( read מַטְמֹנֵי ).
definitions.rootNote: from the same as 3646 in the sense of hiding;
